question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
WITH italian_customer_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cust_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) as total_profit
    FROM sales s
    LEFT JOIN profits p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id AND s.cust_id = p.cust_id AND s.time_id = p.time_id
    WHERE s.cust_id IN (
        SELECT c.cust_id
        FROM customers c
        JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
        WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    )
    AND s.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND s.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
ranked_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_id,
        total_profit,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit ASC) as profit_tier
    FROM italian_customer_profit
)
SELECT 
    profit_tier,
    ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) as lowest_profit,
    ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) as highest_profit
FROM ranked_profit
GROUP BY profit_tier
ORDER BY profit_tier
